results.controlIntent: a. Conduct a risk assessment, including: 1. Identifying threats to and vulnerabilities in the system; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Integrate risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives with system-level risk assessments; c. Document risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. Review risk assessment results [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; e. Disseminate risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

judgment.rationale:
The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null for model "churn-predictor-v1" / endpoint "churn-predictor-endpoint". This means no model card exists for this model. A model card is the primary artifact expected to document risk assessment results (threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood/magnitude of harm, PII impact, intended use, and limitations) as required by RA-3. Without any such documentation:

1. **RA-3(a)**: There is no evidence that a risk assessment was conducted identifying threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood/magnitude of harm, or adverse effects on individuals from PII processing.
2. **RA-3(c)**: Risk assessment results have not been documented in any retrievable artifact (security/privacy plan, risk assessment report, or equivalent).
3. **RA-3(d/e/f)**: With no documented risk assessment, there is no basis to conclude results have been reviewed, disseminated, or updated.

The absence of a model card — the sole retrievable governance artifact — constitutes a clear gap against all sub-requirements of RA-3.
gaps: No model card exists for churn-predictor-v1 (getModelCard returned null) — the primary artifact for documenting risk assessment results is entirely absent.
No evidence of a risk assessment report, security plan, or privacy plan identifying threats and vulnerabilities to the system.
No evidence of likelihood/magnitude-of-harm analysis or PII adverse-effects determination (RA-3(a)(2) and (3)).
No evidence of risk assessment review cadence or update history (RA-3(d) and (f)).
No evidence of dissemination of risk assessment results to defined personnel or roles (RA-3(e)).
Human attestation would be needed to confirm whether any offline/out-of-band risk assessment documentation exists outside the retrievable environment.
